subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 for this issue, or split a smaller Feishu `send` replyTo fix?
rationale: The source-level bug is narrow, but the active overlapping PR has sufficient Feishu proof plus blocking routing regressions and conflicts, so automation should not create a competing branch without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair the existing Feishu anchor PR
options.body: Use the proof-positive PR as the canonical path, fixing its conflicts and preserving current normal-group/P2P invariants before merge.

options.title: Split a smaller replyTo fix
options.body: Close or defer the broad anchor PR only if maintainers want a narrower patch that changes ordinary Feishu `send` replyTo mapping first.

options.title: Keep triage open
options.body: Leave this issue open without new automation until a Feishu maintainer can run a live current-main repro and choose the landing path.

recommendation.title: Repair the existing Feishu anchor PR
recommendation.body: Use the proof-positive PR as the canonical path, fixing its conflicts and preserving current normal-group/P2P invariants before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history routes the affected Feishu action and native card send surfaces through this contributor.
